figures.shows: Workflow of the algorithm. Top: inputs (Hamiltonian, temperature, parameters theta and phi, probability distribution p_theta) feed an optimization process of i layers (a state-preparation block V_theta, then Rz, Ry, Rx rotations and a controlled gate on two qubits, with <H> measured on each qubit), a step from p_theta to the entropy S_theta, and minimization of the loss L(theta, phi). Bottom: the optimized state goes to the optimal work extraction protocol, a circuit of X, CNOT, H and X gates on two qubits followed by measurement, which outputs the passive state rho_00.
